---
title: "Data & code"
---

All data is public, from [NYC Open Data](https://opendata.cityofnewyork.us/). The repo downloads it;
no raw records are stored here.

| Dataset | Open Data ID | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| HPD Order to Repair/Vacate Orders | `tb8q-a3ar` | Fire cases (reason "Fire Damage") |
| HPD Housing Maintenance Code Violations | `wvxf-dwi5` | Main predictors |
| DOB Violations | `3h2n-5cm9` | Predictors; fire and collapse records |
| DOB ECB Violations | `6bgk-3dad` | Severity and penalties |
| DOB Complaints Received | `eabe-havv` | Illegal conversion, work without permit |
| DOB NOW Approved Permits | `rbx6-tga4` | Construction activity |
| PLUTO | `64uk-42ks` | Building traits, matching |
| 311 Service Requests | `erm2-nwe9` | Tenant reports (full study) |

## Rebuild everything

```bash
git clone https://github.com/zeitakz/nyc-building-risk
cd nyc-building-risk
pip install -r requirements.txt
python pilot/fire_analyze.py          # pilot fire result
python pipeline/01_download.py --list # datasets the full pipeline downloads
quarto preview site                   # this website
```

## About the pilot data

The pilot used the Open Data API's server-side aggregation (counts by lot and violation class) one
block at a time. Those counts are saved in `pilot/fire_data.py` and `pilot/collapse_data.py`, so the
pilot can be checked without downloading anything. The full pipeline rebuilds them from the raw
datasets.
